Since 1985

Nobody set out to build an automotive company.

Govind Vanjani started with textiles — exporting to our own subsidiaries in the Caribbean, then the Middle East, Africa and Europe. The gap we filled was reliability. That consistency opened the OEM door, and we walked through it.
